newsitem.title: USA: Pioneer Cos Inc names Ferris president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Pioneer Cos Inc names Ferris president/CEO.

text.p: Pioneer Cos Inc said Monday it elected Michael Ferris to its board and appointed him president and chief executive officer.
Ferris, formerly executive vice president of chemicals and head of the chemicals group at Vulcan Materials Co, is replacing outgoing Richard Kellogg, Jr.
Pioneer said Kellogg has resigned as president and chief executive officer but will continue as a director and will be available for special projects.
Vulcan, confirming Ferris's resignation and move to Pioneer, said it appreciated his "contributions ... and his many years of loyal and dedicated service."

Vulcan told Reuters that its president and chief operating officer Donald James was "holding open options to replace Ferris" and, in the meantime, had appointed executives to report to him on the company's chemical group activities.
